_disclaimer: This is a supplementary rule file for reference. The actual Legal Metrology (General) Rules, 2011 and applicable model approval procedures must be sourced from the Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India (https://consumeraffairs.gov.in). Do not treat this file as authoritative.

rule_set.name: Legal Metrology (General) Rules, 2011
rule_set.issuing_body: Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution, Government of India

model_approval.description: Every pattern/model of a NAWI used in trade or commerce requires model approval from the Central Government before manufacture, import or sale.
model_approval.approving_authority: Controller of Legal Metrology, Department of Consumer Affairs
model_approval.renewal: Model approval shall be renewed if the design is modified or the approval period expires.

initial_verification.description: Verification prior to first use in trade.
initial_verification.note: MPE same as OIML R 76-1 initial verification limits.

subsequent_verification.description: Periodic re-verification by Inspector of Legal Metrology.
subsequent_verification.note: MPE is double the initial verification limits per in-service rules.

instrument_classifications.description: Instruments used in retail trade for weighing commodities
Instruments used in pharmaceutical, jewellery, or high-precision contexts
